html:
Joint CSIR-UGC NET has the most optional PDFs of the NTA forms. Everyone uploads a photo and a signature; many candidates also need a category certificate or a result-awaited attestation form, and each must be a PDF of 50–300 KB.

Dates for the December 2026 cycle

The bulletin lists online applications from 07-10-2026 to 05-11-2026, with late submission from 06-11-2026 to 09-11-2026. Late submission carries a late fee, so aim for the main window.

Work out which PDFs you need

  • Category certificate: if you claim a reserved category. Use the format given in the bulletin annexures.
  • Result-awaited attestation form (Annexure XI): if you are in the final year of your master's. It needs your Head of Department's signature, so get it signed before you start the form.
  • Disability / UDID certificate: for PwD candidates.
  • ID proof (10–200 KB, JPG): only if you verify identity without Aadhaar or DigiLocker.

Then make the two main files

  1. Photo: recent, in colour, white background, about 80% face with both ears and no mask. Limit 10–200 KB, JPG. NTA gives no pixel size; SahiSize keeps 3.5×4.5 cm proportions.
  2. Signature: black ink on white paper, 10–50 KB.

Combining multi-page PDFs

A caste certificate with a second page, or an attestation form on two sheets, must still go up as one file. Add all pages to the certificate step here. If a single page comes out under 50 KB, SahiSize raises the quality until it crosses the minimum; if several pages go over 300 KB, it compresses them while keeping text readable.

Live photo

A live photo is captured during the form and matched with Aadhaar. Take it in the same light and with the same look as your uploaded photo.

If the portal still rejects it

For PDFs, the most common problem is size, either under 50 KB or over 300 KB. Re-run the certificate step. For images, check that the file is JPG and inside its KB range on the Pass check card.
